summary: The launch stopped before model loading because Cosmos recursively imported an older preserved runtime overlay whose frame validator excluded 33; no GPU training began.
evidence: All ranks raised ValueError from the older phiagent_droid_lora_attention_curriculum.py during recursive experiment-package import.
The failure occurred before tokenizer or 14B checkpoint loading and no checkpoint exists.
lessons: Reproducibility copies cannot remain in a recursively imported runtime config directory when their import-time validators differ.
Archive prior runtime overlays into the new immutable experiment directory with hashes, then install exactly one active overlay; keep the project source overlay unchanged.
next_actions: Implement and unit-test recoverable overlay staging, then rerun 33-frame smoke in a new directory.
